talk.text: What does a jury look at before you even say a word?
Your title and hero image. They want one clear idea behind most of your decisions.

label.name: 2 · Proof
label.meta: A drawing that shows the idea

talk.text: Okay, but what if my render already looks amazing?
Not quite. They want the drawing that proves the idea, like this section under the fabric roof.

label.name: 3 · Agreement
label.meta: Plan and section tell one story

talk.text: What gives away an unresolved project?
Drawings that disagree. Jurors follow a stair in the plan, then look for it in the section.
Before your jury, write your idea in one sentence, then find five decisions it explains. Our free guide has the rest.

scenes.line: Free jury guides on the site

outro: Nice. And where is that guide?
caption:
What does a jury look at before you say a word? 👀

Three quiet questions: Is there one clear idea? Do the drawings prove it? Do the plan, section and views agree?

Board shown: a student's community centre for the Law Garden vendors, made with Studio FGA and shared with the student's permission.
